assessment.title: QEMU Flight Software Assessment
assessment.scope_summary: Flight-software build and command parser in QEMU.
limitations: Physical hardware, RF delivery, and on-orbit behavior were not assessed.

claims.statement: Invalid telecommands cannot interrupt command processing.

source_materials.description: Minimized crashing input and debugger trace supplied by the assessor.

limitations: Hardware timing and physical interfaces were not represented.

evidence.description: Minimized crashing telecommand input and debugger trace.

evidence_backed_facts: A minimized input terminates the command task in QEMU.
report_author_inferences: Repeated accepted inputs may interrupt authorized commanding.
assumptions: The emulated command task is representative of the integrated flight image.
evidence_gaps: RF reachability and target-hardware behavior were not assessed.

findings.title: Malformed telecommand terminates command task
limitations: RF reachability and target-hardware behavior were not assessed.

risks.scenario: A malformed accepted frame can terminate command processing and delay authorized commanding.
risks.rationale: Automatic task restart limits duration, but repeated input can retrigger the condition.

conclusions.scope_boundary: Integrated software image in the documented QEMU environment; RF delivery and physical hardware excluded.
conclusions.rationale: Malformed input reproducibly interrupts command processing in the tested environment.

conclusions.scope_boundary: The single declared QEMU assessment claim.
conclusions.rationale: The only gating claim Does Not Meet.
conclusions.aggregation_rule: Does Not Meet when any gating claim Does Not Meet.

limitations: No conclusion is made about RF delivery or on-orbit behavior.
